decision: ADR-0079 probe and heartbeat amendment, 2026-09-23; Q-20260923-z2uc
purpose: Know which device a platform coverage probe actually ran on and which of its reads succeeded, and let a later parser be re-derived from the retained reading without another sweep.
notPurpose: copy of the on-chain benchmark pools
allowedConsumers: per-processor coverage hardware readback in slipway-processor-registry
origin: platform_coverage only, assigned by the server from the canonical PlatformCoverage bootstrap binding; the helper neither receives nor reports it

capture.trigger: a single-use coverage-hardware-v1 grant in the authenticated bootstrap response
capture.grant: exactly one due kind, coverage_hardware_raw.v1; never combined with cargo-baseline-v1 kinds
capture.helper: only a helper version/digest pair the server configuration names explicitly

reading.shape: {"status":"observed","value":V} or {"status":S} with S one of not_present, permission_denied, surface_hidden, unsupported, parse_error; a non-observed reading carries no value
reading.missing: not_present: the file or node does not exist
reading.denied: permission_denied: it exists and the read was refused; never folded into not_present
reading.zero: 0 is an observed value and never means unknown
reading.empty: an observed list may be empty; an unreadable list is a status, not an empty list
reading.strings: no string anywhere in the reading may contain a slash or a Java package name (three or more dot-separated segments that each start with a lowercase letter)

kernel.release: reading of uname release; printable ASCII, 1..=128 bytes

identity.guestUid: reading of the uid the guest reports (id -u); safe integer
identity.kernelUid: reading of the real uid in /proc/self/status; safe integer
identity.capabilityClass: reading of CapEff: none or nonzero; the bitset itself is not kept

groups.cgroupControllers: reading of the controller names in /proc/self/cgroup whose line was readable; at most 16 distinct tokens [a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}; a v2 hierarchy is unified; paths are never kept

cpuPolicies.list: reading of /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policyN; at most 16 entries, distinct policy numbers
cpuPolicies.policy: the N of policyN; integer 0..=1024, always present
cpuPolicies.relatedCpus: reading of related_cpus in range-list form (0-5,7); at most 64 bytes
cpuPolicies.midr: reading of midr_el1 for the policy's first cpu; 0x followed by 8..=16 lowercase hex
cpuPolicies.availableKhz: reading of scaling_available_frequencies; at most 32 safe integers
cpuPolicies.capacity: reading of cpu_capacity for the policy's first cpu; safe integer

caches.list: reading of /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpuN/cache/indexM, deduplicated; at most 64 entries, distinct (level, type, sharedCpuList)
caches.type: data, instruction or unified, always present
caches.sharedCpuList: range-list form, always present; at most 64 bytes
caches.sizeBytes: reading of size converted to bytes; a status when the file was unreadable

meminfo.values: reading per /proc/meminfo line in kB; a line the kernel does not print is not_present; no other line is kept

guestRoot.values: readings of statvfs on the guest root, in bytes; the phone volume the guest sits on, not a job quota

filesystems.entry: reading of {type, inlinecrypt, discard} for the guest root and for /data; type is [a-z0-9_], 1..=16 bytes, a fuse subtype reported as fuse; the flags are booleans
filesystems.notKept: the mount source, the mount point list and every other mount option

thermalZones.list: reading of /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zoneN in index order; at most 128 entries
thermalZones.temp: {"status":"observed","value":integer} with |value| <= 2147483647, or {"status":"unread"} when the read returned nothing or failed

bounds.unknownKeys: any key not named here refuses the whole result; nothing is dropped
bounds.envelope: the server adds domain, profile, helperVersion and collectedAtMs; the device sends only the groups

retention.store: one processor observation of kind coverage_hardware_raw, source class signed_cargo_helper, profile coverage-hardware-v1
retention.afterExpiry: the observation id, clocks and payload digest remain; readers report the payload as expired and never return it
retention.refresh: due again when no retained reading was captured within the signed Cargo basis-age budget (72 h); baseline facts never make it fresh

withdrawal: Disable coverageHardware or remove every helper pin to stop new grants at once; retained readings expire on their own clock. Withdraw the kind through a catalog amendment when no allowed consumer uses it, or on any finding that a field identifies a person, household or application other than the probe.
forbidden: serial, IMEI, second IMEI, MEID, ICCID and SIM identifiers
MAC, SSID, BSSID, neighbor or socket peers, local addresses
soc0 serial_number, ro.serialno and attestation serial fields
the mount table and any mount source
customer environment, arguments and key material
a guessed retail model or codename
